title: Map set 1: name the marked place

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Visakhapatnam Port (Andhra Pradesh) is the marked place. Deepest natural landlocked harbour on the east coast. The others: V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin) is in Tamil Nadu; Vizhinjam Port is in Kerala; Jawaharlal Nehru Port (Nhava Sheva) is in Maharashtra.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Nathu La (Sikkim) is the marked place. Sikkim–Tibet border trade point; old silk route. The others: Shipki La is in Himachal Pradesh; Bom Di La is in Arunachal Pradesh; Bhor Ghat is in Maharashtra.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Tso Moriri (Ladakh) is the marked place. High-altitude Ramsar lake in Changthang. The others: Bhoj Wetland is in Madhya Pradesh; Ashtamudi Lake is in Kerala; Wular Lake is in Jammu & Kashmir.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Renuka Lake (Himachal Pradesh) is the marked place. Smallest Ramsar wetland among the early sites, in Sirmaur. The others: Lonar Lake is in Maharashtra; Sambhar Lake is in Rajasthan; Pangong Tso is in Ladakh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Bhor Ghat (Maharashtra) is the marked place. Mumbai–Pune route across the Western Ghats. The others: Rohtang Pass is in Himachal Pradesh; Shipki La is in Himachal Pradesh; Banihal Pass is in Jammu & Kashmir.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Pench National Park (Madhya Pradesh) is the marked place. Setting of Kipling's Jungle Book; straddles the Maharashtra border. The others: Sundarbans National Park is in West Bengal; Desert National Park is in Rajasthan; Simlipal National Park is in Odisha.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Dhupgarh (Madhya Pradesh) is the marked place. Highest point of the Satpura range, at Pachmarhi. The others: Kangchenjunga is in Sikkim; Nanda Devi is in Uttarakhand; Anamudi is in Kerala.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Majuli (Assam) is the marked place. Large river island in the Brahmaputra; Vaishnava satras. The others: Thal Ghat is in Maharashtra; Sambhar Lake is in Rajasthan; Dhanushkodi is in Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Sasthamkotta Lake (Kerala) is the marked place. Largest freshwater lake in Kerala; Ramsar site. The others: Bhoj Wetland is in Madhya Pradesh; Lonar Lake is in Maharashtra; Tso Moriri is in Ladakh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Bandhavgarh National Park (Madhya Pradesh) is the marked place. High density of tigers in the Vindhyan hills. The others: Hemis National Park is in Ladakh; Bandipur National Park is in Karnataka; Ranthambore National Park is in Rajasthan.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Bom Di La (Arunachal Pradesh) is the marked place. Links Arunachal with Lhasa route; Tawang road. The others: Shipki La is in Himachal Pradesh; Khardung La is in Ladakh; Rohtang Pass is in Himachal Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Jawaharlal Nehru Port (Nhava Sheva) (Maharashtra) is the marked place. India's largest container port, across the harbour from Mumbai. The others: Haldia is in West Bengal; New Mangalore Port is in Karnataka; Mormugao Port is in Goa.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Anamudi (Kerala) is the marked place. Highest peak in peninsular India (Anamalai Hills). The others: Saramati is in Nagaland; Guru Shikhar is in Rajasthan; Mahendragiri is in Odisha.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Kandla (Deendayal Port) (Gujarat) is the marked place. Tidal port in the Gulf of Kutch; major cargo port. The others: Jawaharlal Nehru Port (Nhava Sheva) is in Maharashtra; New Mangalore Port is in Karnataka; Haldia is in West Bengal.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve (Tamil Nadu) is the marked place. Marine reserve between India and Sri Lanka; dugongs. The others: Panna National Park is in Madhya Pradesh; Gir National Park is in Gujarat; Bodh Gaya is in Bihar.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Hemis National Park (Ladakh) is the marked place. Snow leopard; largest national park in India. The others: Silent Valley National Park is in Kerala; Kanha National Park is in Madhya Pradesh; Dudhwa National Park is in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Saramati (Nagaland) is the marked place. Highest peak of Nagaland, on the Myanmar border. The others: Nanda Devi is in Uttarakhand; Kangchenjunga is in Sikkim; Dhupgarh is in Madhya Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Jog Falls (Karnataka) is the marked place. Sharavathi river plunges over the Western Ghats. The others: Athirappilly Falls is in Kerala; Dhuandhar Falls is in Madhya Pradesh; Hogenakkal Falls is in Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Sardar Sarovar Dam (Gujarat) is the marked place. On the Narmada; Statue of Unity stands nearby. The others: Bhakra Nangal Dam is in Himachal Pradesh / Punjab; Idukki Dam is in Kerala; Nagarjuna Sagar Dam is in Telangana / Andhra Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Hogenakkal Falls (Tamil Nadu) is the marked place. Kaveri falls on the Karnataka–Tamil Nadu border. The others: Mahendragiri is in Odisha; Kanha National Park is in Madhya Pradesh; V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin) is in Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Konark Sun Temple (Odisha) is the marked place. Chariot-shaped 13th-century temple of the Eastern Ganga kings. The others: Hampi is in Karnataka; Sanchi is in Madhya Pradesh; Bodh Gaya is in Bihar.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Gir National Park (Gujarat) is the marked place. Only wild home of the Asiatic lion. The others: Bhitarkanika National Park is in Odisha; Desert National Park is in Rajasthan; Namdapha National Park is in Arunachal Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Loktak Lake (Manipur) is the marked place. Floating phumdis; Keibul Lamjao, the only floating national park. The others: Bhoj Wetland is in Madhya Pradesh; Tso Moriri is in Ladakh; Kolleru Lake is in Andhra Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Indravati National Park (Chhattisgarh) is the marked place. Wild buffalo in Bastar along the Indravati river. The others: Panna National Park is in Madhya Pradesh; Jim Corbett National Park is in Uttarakhand; Manas National Park is in Assam.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam (Telangana / Andhra Pradesh) is the marked place. Masonry dam on the Krishna. The others: Tungabhadra Dam is in Karnataka; Hirakud Dam is in Odisha; Mettur Dam is in Tamil Nadu.
